passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 2: The market approach (web publication; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: Its strength lies in grounding valuations in real world data, but its usefulness is constrained by the scarcity of publicly available or truly comparable deals, especially for early stage assets.

passages.source_title: IVSC. International Valuation Standards effective 31 January 2025, RED-LINE EDITION (copy hosted by ICAEW; each registered passage also appears word for word in the January 2022 edition, so it is unchanged text)
passages.text: When comparable market information does not relate to the exact or substantially the same asset, the valuer must perform a comparative analysis of qualitative and quantitative similarities and differences between the comparable assets and the subject asset.

If at the time a fairness opinion is issued to the board of directors of a company the member issuing the fairness opinion knows or has reason to know that the fairness opinion will be provided or described to the company's public shareholders, the member must disclose in the fairness opinion:

passages.source_title: 17 CFR 229.1015 (Item 1015 of Regulation M-A): Reports, opinions, appraisals and negotiations (eCFR; scope: Rule 13e-3 transactions and the cross-referenced proxy items)
passages.text: (6) Furnish a summary concerning the negotiation, report, opinion or appraisal. The summary must include, but need not be limited to, the procedures followed; the findings and recommendations; the bases for and methods of arriving at such findings and recommendations; instructions received from the subject company or affiliate; and any limitation imposed by the subject company or affiliate on the scope of the investigation.
